## Customer success explained with key statistics

Customer success is a proactive strategy that helps customers achieve their goals using your product or service. This long-term process focuses on lasting outcomes rather than short-term wins.

The primary goal is to ensure customers see clear results, stay engaged and active, and feel confident about your products and services. To achieve this, you can leverage the best AI tools for customer success. [...] Pro tip: Segment your reports by customer tier, so you can respond faster to high-priority accounts.

### 2. Breeze Customer Agent

Image via Breeze Customer Agent

Breeze Customer Agent is a HubSpot-developed agentic AI chatbot that engages with leads throughout the buyer’s journey. It helps marketers generate leads by prompting users to enter their contact details. Sales reps can then book meetings and qualify prospects through discovery questions, and service agents handle common inquiries.

As such, Breeze Customer Agent automates most routine activities, allowing customer-facing teams to focus on more complex tasks and deliver the best possible experiences. [...] ### 4. Base AI

Image via Base AI

Base AI unifies all the scattered customer data processed by your business. It drives customer engagement with automation, working without constantly being managed by humans.

The platform then consolidates customer journey data from various systems. It feeds this data into AI agents that provide insights, activate campaigns, and manage relationships at scale.

Base AI is excellent for customer success teams due to its suite of specialized AI agents. These agents manage core customer success tasks automatically and precisely.

They also help build advocacy initiatives, match customer references to active deals, and support the creation of targeted engagement campaigns. Lastly, they analyze customer feedback to inform strategic decisions.
